messages:
Nina Park: Heads-up: rollout for gateway-chart v1.8.0 hit degraded canary in ap-south. Health: readiness failing intermittently. Not CPU/memory.

deploy-bot: Promotion attempt: chart=redwood/gateway-chart, version=1.8.0 -> previous=1.7.6
Canary status: 2/4 healthy
Event: readiness probe HTTP 502 from upstream service

Ethan Wu: Might be a config toggle in values that flips upstream routing to use the new connection pool. Quick mitigation: canary-values override to revert `routing.v2=false` for canary only, then re-evaluate.

Carlos M: Rollback option exists but will drop traffic metrics we've been collecting. I'm +1 for canary-values first. Also, if we keep auto-rollback enabled, deploy-bot will revert after threshold; set `--auto-rollback false` when we promote with override.

Nina Park: Can we do a soft promote with `replicaFraction=0.25` instead of full canary to reduce shock? Change window is open for 40m.

deploy-bot: Supported command: `deploy-bot: promote gateway-chart 1.8.0 --canary-values routing.v2=false,replicaFraction=0.25 --auto-rollback false`

Ethan Wu: I'll initiate that now. Monitoring stack: `kubectl -n ap-south get pods -l app=gateway -o wide` and `oc logs` for the proxy container.

Carlos M: If that stabilizes, we should schedule a quick branch to make the routing toggle default-safe (idempotent) and then do a full promote with the toggle on. If it doesn't stabilize within 10m, we'll do immediate rollback to 1.7.6.

Nina Park: Action list:
- Ethan: run soft canary override now and monitor for 10m
- Carlos: prepare rollback play if needed
- Nina: draft short release-note note explaining the canary override and follow-up fix

Ethan Wu: Triggered: `deploy-bot: promote gateway-chart 1.8.0 --canary-values routing.v2=false,replicaFraction=0.25 --auto-rollback false`

deploy-bot: Promotion started with canary replicaFraction=0.25. Reporting health in thread.

Ethan Wu: +10m update: soft canary healthy, readiness stabilized. I'll keep it monitored for another 15m then flag for full rollout prep.

(End thread for now)
